snippet.title: Don't Let It Starve - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A horror roguelike deckbuilder. You're trapped in a kitchen, forced to feed a half-chef monster that crawls through the vents. Don't let it starve.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3930510/Dont_Let_It_Starve/
